purpose: Choose a useful R90 stopping point without treating epoch 100 as a goal, then decide whether that frozen checkpoint is suitable for an emergency ONNX package.

excluded_stages.epochs_5_to_15: The stored validation and live previews show near-identity behavior; they are retained on disk but are not useful reconstruction candidates.
excluded_stages.epochs_after_55: No fully completed checkpoint exists because training was stopped after epoch 55.

real_appearance.interpretation: Raw-based appearance measurements detect strength and artifacts but are not shape truth.

sem_contour.method: The frozen Chan-Vese contour rule, fixed SEM pairing, and translation-only alignment used in the completed R90 epoch-55 validation.
sem_contour.primary_concern: Exposure 18 and 19 optical-edge expansion, especially the worst exposure rather than only the overall median.

stored_training_validation.policy: Read the metrics already embedded in each checkpoint; do not open the sealed holdout again for checkpoint selection.

selection_policy.method: Pareto comparison with safety-first tie breaking; no single weighted average and no visually selected image decides the checkpoint.
objectives: SEM contour agreement over all 36 physical pillars and all 12 exposures
SEM worst-exposure contour agreement and radial edge shift
low dark-edge and off-source edge warnings
stored clean-input preservation and motion stability
tie_breaking: Remove checkpoints with a clear worst-exposure contour failure or low-magnification dark-outline regression.
Among the remaining non-dominated checkpoints, prefer the one with useful detail at all three magnifications.
If two checkpoints are practically indistinguishable, prefer the earlier epoch.

after_one_checkpoint_is_frozen: Reconstruct all 301 frames and recompute the six locked motion sequences.
Verify full-image versus canonical tiled reconstruction and multiple core sizes.
Export ONNX and verify PyTorch versus ONNX parity on synthetic, 5x, 20x, 50x, SEM, and JunHua inputs.
Run an extracted-archive smoke test and verify every manifest hash.
confirmation_policy.external_gmf: Unavailable until a valid license key is supplied; do not claim external GMF validation.
confirmation_policy.delivery_decision: Package only if the frozen checkpoint remains stable in confirmation. Otherwise keep R61 as the emergency delivery package.
